items.text: First of all, thank you for playing Leaf Blower Co. and for taking the time to share your feedback with us.

Whether it's through Steam reviews, community discussions, or conversations on our Discord server, your comments help us improve the game and make it more enjoyable for everyone. We read your feedback carefully, and this update includes a couple of improvements based on issues reported by the community.

In this patch, we've fixed a problem with key remapping not working correctly and added a new Photosensitivity Mode option. When enabled, this setting disables the leaf-clearing wipe effect to reduce flashing visuals and provide a more comfortable experience for players with photosensitivity.
Fixed an issue where key remapping was not working correctly.
Added a new Photosensitivity Mode option in General Settings. When enabled, the leaf-clearing wipe effect is disabled to reduce flashing visuals. Recommended for players with photosensitivity.

items.text: As always, thank you for your feedback and for being part of the Leaf Blower Co. community. We read your messages, suggestions, and reports every day, and it’s incredibly rewarding to see how actively you’re playing and helping the game grow. This update includes a large set of improvements, fixes, and changes inspired by your input.

Levels are now played in a fixed order (no optional unlock levels after each day). Instead of the 23 levels being scattered over posters, 10 days of progress and 10 optional days – the campaign plays in order – so the new end day of the campaign is day 24. If you are mid-way through a play through, it will remain on the old system. You can choose to reset your career to initiate this new system.
Some seasonal levels have moved from Posters to Postcards.

Just in time for the holidays and Steam’s Winter Sale, we’re excited to unwrap a little gift for you. Actually… a pretty big one!
Say hello to the Winter Wonders Update ❄️🍃
This update brings new places to clean, a festive surprise, and one of the biggest performance upgrades Leaf Blower Co. has had since launch.
A brand new main job The Gardens, unlocked on Day 11
The Japanese Temple, unlocked as a Side Job after finishing The Gardens
A fun Christmas Level, hiding under the Christmas Tree in your office 🎁
Steam Cloud Saves are now enabled and working for everyone
A massive upgrade to our Lighting and Graphics systems, bringing big performance gains, especially on older or lower-end machines
We hope you enjoy the new content, the many quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, and performance boosts. We’re incredibly excited about 2026 and what’s coming next for Leaf Blower Co. 💚
If you’d like a more detailed breakdown of everything included in this update, you’ll find it below 👇
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3571710/Leaf_Blower_Co/"]
This update is all about speed, stability, and polish — plus some brand-new places to clean up.
We’ve done a major overhaul of lighting and rendering to dramatically improve performance across the board.
Lumen has been disabled for now
(Lumen is Unreal Engine’s fully dynamic lighting system — it looks great, but it’s extremely demanding, especially in large, physics-heavy levels.)
Nanite has also been disabled
Reverted to DirectX 11 for better stability and compatibility with older graphics cards.
Much higher and more consistent FPS ( for many this will be double the previous framerate).
Far fewer crashes, especially on longer play sessions
This has resulted in one of the biggest performance gains since launch.
Christmas – available immediately
Japanese Temple – unlocked on Day 11+
Gardens – unlocked on Day 11+
More variety, more atmosphere, more leaves to deal with.

releases.displayName: 🍂 December Update: Lighting Rework, Shredder Boosts and What’s Coming Next

notes.title: We wanted to give you an update as we enter December.

items.text: We've been looking to your feedback and have begun the extensive process of reworking the lighting system of Leaf Blower, as we think that's the culprit behind a significant proportion of the crashes, stuttering and other performance issues. More on that below! But in the mean-time we've got a few key notes for you in this update:

The Shredders will now be able to return to their full Dev tool glory for all players upon reaching Day 11. Once you finish the last Campaign Job, you'll see new upgrades in the shop to buy for each Shredder to ramp up their capacity; we think this is a good middle ground between keeping the intended experience but also allowing our players to play how you want. Let us know your thoughts!

We've also put a lot of work into the collision detection in every level, which should hopefully address those pesky leaves making their way out of bounds! ❗A word of warning though: pushing leaves against walls with your almighty rake has the highest chance of leaves exiting the play area, so we'd suggest avoiding this where possible.
And of course, there have been numerous small tweaks, fixes and alterations to make the game feel as smooth as possible.
So that's what we've added now. Here's what's to come (apologies, some of this is unavoidably technical):
Switching from Lumen/Nanites to prebaked scenes. This should increase performance and decrease GPU cost.
Converting from DirectX12 to DirectX11 compatibility, which should significantly increase performance on older and lower spec machines.
Locking frame rates within game engine, as V-Sync doesn't always help here, which should help with overheating.
Steam Deck specific performance improvements;
Steam Cloud saves;
More content! In addition to getting the above core fixes (and more) we'll be adding new levels and additional gameplay appropriate for the winter season!
Thank you for being with us on the journey so far, we hope that you'll stick with us as we continue to make Leaf Blower bigger & better, so it can be the game our players really deserve! 💚

Hi everyone!

Thank you so much for supporting Leaf Blower Co. during launch, for sending us your thoughts, and for helping us make the game better every single day. Your feedback over the past few days has been incredible. We read everything, and it genuinely guides what we work on next.

We have also created a dedicated feedback thread so you can easily report bugs, see what has already been flagged by other players, and check what we are actively working on. Thank you for keeping the reports clear, helpful and kind. It truly makes a difference.

💚 If you enjoyed the game, a Steam review helps us more than you can imagine, especially in these first few days after release. Even a short first impression review boosts visibility. You can always edit it later if you want to share more details.
A huge thank you to everyone who already left one. You have helped the game reach so many new cozy game enjoyers!

We noticed that many of you were having trouble spotting the entrance to the shop, so we improved its visibility. The postcard has been replaced with a full sized poster, making it much easier to notice.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621723/994d83ed8e296af13eb2466137eed419a07664cb.png"]
On Day 2, if you try to start the job without owning a shredder yet, the game will now gently guide you to the shop with a marker. This prevents confusion and helps new players progress smoothly.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621723/2d3214bc5481d4f3f13cbc6e2eed777e4ed95ec3.png"]

Some of you brilliant players managed to enjoy what was basically our internal overpowered dev version of the Shredder. It was not meant to be that strong for the full release but the setting slipped through our final checklist.

With this update we are restoring the Shredder to its intended balanced version. This makes progression feel more rewarding, encourages more consistent use of the signature leaf blower and keeps the early game enjoyable rather than instantly completed.
Shredder Mark 1: 10
Shredder Mark 2: 20
The tool is still powerful and very useful, just no longer accidentally infinite.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621723/181cd4ec526d83abe45315d56ebee7abd267cf21.png"]
Deleting a movable fan with Right Mouse or Left Gamepad button could break the entire interaction system. This is now fully fixed, so you can continue blowing things around without fear.
Collision has been updated so you can no longer step outside the level boundaries. No more unexpected void adventures between the chess pieces.
The settings text has been updated to use correct terminology and to be easier to find.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621723/1f9d5e3ab20caf29040e02f506e43b5fec4844b3.png"]
You can no longer exit out of bounds in the Shop through doorways
You can no longer exit out of bounds in Mr. Johnsons and the Neighbors House
The starting position on the Basketball Court was moved back and the bin was moved forward so you can spot it more easily
Cash Cleaner Simulator graffiti has been updated to the latest version

We are reading your reports, your ideas and your screenshots. Please keep them coming. Leaf Blower Co. is growing because of your support and your kindness. More updates are already in the works. Stay tuned and keep blowing those leaves 🍃
— The Leaf Blower Team

notes.title: 🌱 Hey there! Your feedback has helped us make Leaf Blower Co. even better!

items.text: As you might have seen in our previous post, we are heading to Cologne for Gamescom 2025. The event runs from 20 to 24 August and if you are also attending, you can come meet us in person.

We will be at The Indie Arena Booth where you can try out Forklift games, chat with the team, pick up exclusive giveaways and snap some fun photos with us. We will be there in full leaf blowing spirit and would love to meet you.

But there is more. Steam is already featuring all Gamescom participants today and to celebrate we have updated the Leaf Blower Co. Demo. This update is based directly on your feedback and we are incredibly grateful for all the suggestions, bug reports and ideas you have shared. They have helped us make the game even better for everyone. Thank you!
And as special treat, we've even switched out one of the Freeplay levels - jump into the calming zen of the new Japanese Courtyard location now!
